author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: हे कमलदलवदायतनेत्र । त्वत्तः भूतानां भवाप्ययौ । 'अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा' (७.६) इत्यादिना सप्तमाध्यायादिषु विस्तरशो मया श्रुतौ अव्ययं माहात्म्यमपि च श्रुतम् ॥ ११.२॥
translation:
In fact, from Thee, the origination and dissolution of beings have been heard at length by me, O One that has eyes broad as the lotus leaf; also, Thine undiminishing glory.
A. Praising the Lord's words Arjuna solicits for revelation of the Visvarupa.
